scope: Russia medical discovery — Kazan Federal University General Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Kazan Federal University lists English General Medicine as a six-year specialist programme with 2026/27 tuition of RUB 653,400.
The 2026 admission annex lists English General Medicine as full-time self-funded study with Fundamentals of Human Biology and English entrance examinations, minimum 40 points each, and 65 places.
KFU states that international applicants for General Medicine must arrive in Russia in person for entrance exams.

holdReasons: Current official clinical-training, accommodation/support and medical-professional recognition evidence was not assembled for a complete student-facing package.
A public payload should not infer clinical hospital names, residency outcomes or international licensing eligibility from the core programme and admissions pages.
nextAction: Complete primary clinical-site, housing/support and professional-recognition evidence, then build the executable 0077 payload.
